Usage: openldr [options] [command]

OpenLDR CE operator CLI

Options:
  --actor <name>           audit actor name for this invocation (defaults to
                           the OS user)
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  workflows                Inspect workflows
  connectors               Inspect and update host connector configuration
  import                   Import from a database connector with a plugin that
                           declares an import source
  doctor [options]         List what this install still needs before it is
                           ready (the same checks as Settings, Setup checks)
  health [options]         Probe every adapter (auth, blob, eventing,
                           target-store)
  errors                   Error-code catalog
  update                   Version and update checks
  fhir                     FHIR R4 utilities
  db                       Database migrations and seeding
  auth                     Authentication provider binding
  settings                 App settings — feature flags and danger-zone actions
  roles                    Capability roles — CRUD + grant/revoke
  data-exposure            Column exposure policy for
                           dashboards/queries/reports (a running server picks
                           up CLI changes after its next in-app policy save or
                           restart)
  test-catalog             National test catalog: the tests offered and which
                           this lab runs
  patients                 The patient index (read-only; the source system owns
                           patients)
  facilities               Facility registry (facility_registry)
  query                    Custom queries (the SQL behind reports)
  sync                     lab⇄central sync status + control
  target-store             Target warehouse (Postgres/SQL Server/MySQL/MariaDB)
                           tools
  storage                  Object storage tools
  terminology              Terminology service (CodeSystem/ValueSet/ConceptMap)
  forms                    FHIR forms (Questionnaire) utilities
  report-design            Report Designer page designs
  report-def               Data-driven report definitions
  ingest [options] <file>  Ingest a payload through the pipeline (accept +
                           drain)
  pipeline                 Inspect the ingest pipeline
  queue                    Inspect the event queue
  provenance               Provenance tooling
  plugin                   Manage WASM ingest plugins
  report                   Domain reports over the analytics DB
  audit                    Append-only audit log
  users                    Local user management
  user                     Local user management (decoupled from the IdP)
  export [options]         Export the complete dataset: canonical FHIR (NDJSON
                           + Bundle) + flat-table CSV + manifest
  layouts                  Studio layouts: which sidebar pages show and the
                           first page, with a default per role
  market                   Plugin/artifact marketplace
  artifact                 Author marketplace artifacts
                           (scaffold/build/sign/publish)
  help [command]           display help for command
